project_name: PawHaus Resort VIP Portal - A/B Test Variant

design_philosophy.vibe: High-end editorial, Aman/Six Senses tier luxury, warm minimalism.
core_principles: Editorial Pacing: Generous white space, sparse copy, cinematic imagery.
Organic Warmth: Contrast the original 'dark forest' variant with bright, sunlit linen textures and deep green typography.
Clear Duality: The A/B test centers on a two-lane offer (VIP vs Public). These must feel structurally equal but experientially distinct.
Dog-First Luxury: Emphasize pets as equal VIP guests through layout and imagery, not just fine print.

rules: Never use default bold for headings; use font-medium or font-light.
Overlines and small labels MUST be uppercase with wide tracking.
Ensure hierarchy gap: H1 to body should feel like a deliberate leap.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind p-8 to p-24). Elements should breathe like a print magazine.

bento_grid.marketing: Use asymmetric grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) for amenities and gallery. Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4.
bento_grid.booking_funnel: Use split layout: col-span-8 for forms/selection, col-span-4 for the Sticky Summary Card.

surface_styles.header: Crystal Glass style: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF9F6]/80 with a delicate 1px border-b border-[#2C4C3B]/10.
surface_styles.offer_cards: Flat background (primary or secondary), 1px solid border subtle, NO drop shadow. On hover: slight -translate-y-1 and border darkens.
surface_styles.sticky_summary: Soft clay background (#EBE8E0) with crisp inner borders separating line items.

html_tailwind: Hero Section: Split layout or overlapping large cards over imagery.
Two-Lane Funnel: Custom HTML cards. Left (VIP) emphasizes exclusivity. Right (Public) emphasizes ease.
Amenities/Gallery: Asymmetric bento grids using raw Tailwind for precise artistic control.
shadcn_ui: Forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox for the 3-step booking flow.
Calendar: Use Shadcn Datepicker for Stay selection.
Dialog: For expanded room details or refund policy.
shadcn_ui.Note: Override Shadcn default border-radius to rounded-none or rounded-sm for an architectural, high-end feel.
components_strategy.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, specific cards) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='vip-code-input').

landing_above_fold.structure: Immersive hero image with a semi-transparent warm overlay. The 'Two-Lane Offer' cards sit overlapping the bottom of the hero or directly below it.
landing_above_fold.vip_card: Heading: 'Founders VIP'. Status: 'Sold Out'. Interaction: Input field for code (PAWVIP) + Unlock Button.
landing_above_fold.public_card: Heading: 'Pre-Launch Public'. Status: '20% Off'. Interaction: 'Continue' Button.

booking_funnel.step_1_stay: List the three rooms (Petite, Standard, Monolith). Large photography, clear capacity (Guests + Pets). 'Select Dates' datepicker.
booking_funnel.step_2_guests: Dropdowns/counters for Adults, Children, and Dogs. Collect dog names/breeds for personalized luxury.
booking_funnel.step_3_review: Final review, Stripe payment integration block.
booking_funnel.sticky_summary: Must be visible on desktop throughout Steps 1-3. Shows Room Base Price, Hot Tub Premium (if applicable), Active Discount (20% or VIP), and Total.

marketing_sections.vip_benefits: Icon list or text grid detailing what Founders get.
marketing_sections.amenities: Grid showing 'Included in every unit' (e.g., Dog beds, treats) and 'On-site'.
marketing_sections.transparency: A classy, muted section explaining construction transparency and refund policies.
